description: As the Regional HMIS Coordinator, you need to send a formal data quality follow-up message to the district team. Using the DHIS2 Messaging app (login: admin/district), compose and send a new message with the subject 'Bo District Q4 2023 Data Review'. The message must be addressed to at least one user group (e.g., 'Bo District M&E officers' or similar). The body of the message must be substantive (at least 200 characters) and address data completeness for the Q4 2023 period. After sending the message in DHIS2, save a copy of the message text (subject and body) to a file named '/home/ga/Desktop/bo_q4_2023_data_review_message.txt'.
